title: Market Row | Internal Financing Memorandum
subtitle: First-mortgage refinance | As of August 31, 2026 | Internal review only - not a credit commitment or legal opinion
sections: [{"heading":"Purpose and recommendation","paragraphs":["This memorandum presents an internal-review underwriting of a proposed first-mortgage refinance of Market Row, a fictional retail property at 1800 Market Bench Avenue, Columbus, OH (Property-and-Plan.pdf p.1). All figures are as of the August 31, 2026 as-of date and are derived solely from the supplied packet: Rent-Roll.xlsx (as of 2026-08-31), Lease-File.pdf, T12-Statement.pdf (September 2025 - August 2026), Property-and-Plan.pdf and Lender-Terms.pdf (indicative, nonbinding terms dated September 1, 2026).","Recommendation: proceed to full credit review on a maximum first-mortgage loan of approximately $5,327,928, which is the DSCR-constrained ceiling under the lender's stated tests. At that principal the transaction repays the $3,400,000 existing debt, funds a 1.00% origination fee ($53,279) and $48,000 of fixed closing costs, and still returns approximately $1,826,648 of net cash to the borrower, satisfying the stated cash-out objective. The recommendation is conditional: no appraisal, environmental report, sponsor track record, market comparables or completed credit approval is in the packet, and the forward operating plan is a supplied scenario rather than a lender-approved forecast.","Debt service coverage is tight by design. The DSCR test binds exactly at the 1.25x minimum on underwritten NCF at the 6.50% sizing rate; measured at the 6.25% contract rate, first-year coverage on underwritten NCF is approximately 1.28x. Coverage measured on historical T12 NCF ($498,400) rather than the underwritten scenario would be approximately 1.15x against sizing debt service, which is below the 1.25x minimum and is the principal credit sensitivity in this file."},{"heading":"Property, occupancy and contractual rent (as of 2026-08-31)","paragraphs":["The rent roll shows eight suites totaling 23,000 rentable square feet, of which seven suites and 20,200 square feet are occupied: 87.50% occupancy by count and 87.83% by area. Suite 108 (2,800 SF) is vacant; its $5,200 monthly market rent is shown for context and is not contractual income (Rent-Roll.xlsx rows 7-14, note row 17).","Monthly base rent as printed on the rent roll is $48,600. Reconciling suite 101 to the executed first amendment (Lease-File.pdf p.2, signed by both parties 2026-07-20, effective 2026-08-01) raises that suite from $7,000 to $7,500, producing effective contractual monthly base rent of $49,100 ($589,200 annualized). The rent roll itself carries a manager note directing this reconciliation (Rent-Roll.xlsx row 19). Annualized contractual rent is a point-in-time figure and is deliberately not reconciled to either the T12 or the supplied forward scenario."],"table":{"headers":["Unit","Tenant","Area SF","Status","Rent roll monthly","Effective monthly","Expiry"],"rows":[["101","Tenant A LLC","1,800","Occupied","7,000","7,500","2031-08-31"],["102","Tenant B LLC","2,200","Occupied","5,500","5,500","2028-08-31"],["103","Tenant C LLC","2,500","Occupied","6,000","6,000","2029-08-31"],["104","Tenant D LLC","3,200","Occupied","7,200","7,200","2030-08-31"],["105","Tenant E LLC","4,000","Occupied","9,000","9,000","2031-08-31"],["106","Tenant F LLC","5,000","Occupied","10,500","10,500","2027-08-31"],["107","Tenant G LLC","1,500","Occupied","3,400","3,400","2028-08-31"],["108","Vacant","2,800","Vacant","0","0","n/a"],["Total","","23,000","","48,600","49,100",""]]}},{"heading":"Tenant and lease discussion - suite 101","paragraphs":["Suite 101 (1,800 SF, Tenant A LLC) is the only suite with conflicting evidence, and the file contains three documents of different authority. The executed lease (Lease-File.pdf p.1, signed 2025-08-15, commencement 2025-09-01) states base rent of $7,000 per month as of August 31, 2026, expiry 2031-08-31, a $15,000 security deposit and no base-rent increase before September 1, 2027. The executed first amendment (p.2, signed by both parties 2026-07-20) changes base rent to $7,500 per month effective 2026-08-01 and expressly leaves the expiration date and the $15,000 deposit unchanged. An attached broker proposal dated 2026-08-27 contemplating $8,000 per month and extension to 2033 is UNSIGNED and, per Section 6 of the lease, does not modify the executed agreement.","Authoritative conclusions: current monthly rent for suite 101 is $7,500; current expiry remains 2031-08-31; the security deposit is $15,000 and is not income. The $8,000 proposal is excluded from all underwriting, and the amendment's $7,500 supersedes the stale $7,000 shown on the rent roll.","The lease grants one conditional renewal option requiring no uncured default and written notice at least 180 days before expiration (Lease-File.pdf p.1 Section 5). No exercise notice, landlord acknowledgment or exercising amendment is in the packet, so the renewal option is NOT evidenced as exercised and the expiry is not extended.","Rollover exposure: suite 106 (5,000 SF, 21.7% of area, $10,500 per month) expires 2027-08-31, inside the 60-month loan term, followed by suites 102 and 107 in 2028. Combined with the vacant suite 108, roughly 34% of rentable area is either vacant or rolling within the first two loan years. No leasing costs, downtime or tenant credit information is supplied, so re-tenanting risk is unquantified."},{"heading":"Historical performance - T12 September 2025 through August 2026","paragraphs":["The trailing twelve months (T12-Statement.pdf pp.1-2, Annual column) produce effective gross income of $723,600 from $645,600 gross potential base rent less $46,800 vacancy, $14,400 concessions and $3,600 bad debt, plus $142,800 other income and recoveries. Operating expenses excluding reserves, capital improvements, debt service and depreciation total $216,000 (31.0% of EGI), yielding NOI before replacement reserves of $507,600. Replacement reserves of $9,200 are charged below NOI, giving NCF after reserves of $498,400.","Per Property-and-Plan.pdf p.1, the accounting package may label cash flow after reserves as 'property NOI'; that label is not adopted here. NOI before reserves and NCF after reserves are reported separately, and the $98,000 of capital improvements, $294,000 of existing loan principal and interest and $180,000 of depreciation shown on the statement are reconciliation items below operating income, not operating expenses."],"table":{"headers":["T12 line (Sep-2025 - Aug-2026)","Amount (USD)"],"rows":[["Gross potential base rent","645,600"],["Vacancy loss","(46,800)"],["Concessions","(14,400)"],["Bad debt","(3,600)"],["Other income / recoveries","142,800"],["T12 effective gross income","723,600"],["T12 operating expenses (excl. reserves/capex/debt/depreciation)","216,000"],["T12 NOI before replacement reserves","507,600"],["Replacement reserves (below NOI)","9,200"],["T12 NCF after reserves","498,400"],["Memo - capital improvements (below cash flow)","98,000"],["Memo - existing loan principal and interest","294,000"],["Memo - depreciation (noncash)","180,000"]]}},{"heading":"Underwritten cash flow - supplied scenario, September 2026 forward","paragraphs":["The forward scenario is prescribed by Property-and-Plan.pdf p.2 and is not derived from the T12 or from annualized rent roll. Gross potential base rent of $657,600 less a 6.00% combined revenue loss ($39,456) gives $618,144 of effective base rental income; adding $150,000 of other income produces underwritten EGI of $768,144.","Expenses follow the plan's line-by-line treatment: taxes stepped to $90,000; insurance at the plan's $27,600 renewal allowance; utilities $19,200 and payroll $18,000 and administrative $14,400 at T12 actual; repairs and maintenance $24,000 after removing $4,800 of one-time casualty cleanup; and a normalized management fee equal to the greater of the T12 actual $24,000 and 4.00% of underwritten EGI, i.e. $30,725.76. Total underwritten operating expense before reserves is $223,925.76 (29.2% of EGI), giving NOI before reserves of $544,218.24. Replacement reserves of $0.20 per SF on 23,000 SF ($4,600) are deducted after NOI for NCF of $539,618.24.","Capitalizing underwritten NOI before reserves at the lender's 6.50% rate (Lender-Terms.pdf p.1) gives an indicative value of $8,372,588, or about $364 per rentable SF. This is a lender sizing convention only; no appraisal is supplied or implied."],"table":{"headers":["Underwritten line (annual)","Amount (USD)"],"rows":[["Gross potential base rent","657,600"],["Combined revenue loss at 6.00%","(39,456)"],["Effective base rental income","618,144"],["Other income / recoveries","150,000"],["Underwritten EGI","768,144"],["Real estate taxes","90,000"],["Property insurance (plan allowance)","27,600"],["Utilities","19,200"],["Repairs and maintenance (net of $4,800 one-time)","24,000"],["Payroll / contract labor","18,000"],["Administrative / legal","14,400"],["Management fee (greater of $24,000 and 4.00% of EGI)","30,726"],["Underwritten operating expenses before reserves","223,926"],["Underwritten NOI before reserves","544,218"],["Replacement reserves ($0.20/SF x 23,000 SF)","4,600"],["Underwritten NCF after reserves","539,618"],["Indicative value at 6.50% cap rate","8,372,588"]]}},{"heading":"Loan sizing and debt service","paragraphs":["Sizing follows the lender's definitions exactly. The sizing rate is the greater of the 6.25% contract rate and the 6.50% underwriting floor, i.e. 6.50%, amortized over 25 years with monthly payments; annual debt service equals twelve monthly payments, so the annual debt constant per dollar of principal is 0.08102486. The interest-only period is zero months, so first-year contractual debt service is fully amortizing at the 6.25% contract rate (constant 0.07915372), producing $421,760 versus $431,695 of sizing debt service - a $9,934 difference driven solely by the 25 bps rate gap.","The DSCR test binds. LTV allows $5,442,182 (65% of $8,372,588); DSCR allows $5,327,928 (($539,618.24 / 1.25x) / 0.08102486); debt yield allows $6,046,869 ($544,218.24 / 9.00%). The maximum loan is therefore $5,327,928, equal to 63.63% LTV and a 10.21% debt yield, with DSCR exactly 1.25x at the sizing rate and about 1.279x on first-year contractual debt service."],"table":{"headers":["Sizing test","Limit (USD)","Binding"],"rows":[["LTV - 65.00% of $8,372,588","5,442,182","No"],["DSCR - 1.25x on NCF $539,618 at 6.50%, 25-yr amortization","5,327,928","Yes"],["Debt yield - 9.00% on NOI before reserves $544,218","6,046,869","No"],["Maximum loan","5,327,928","DSCR"],["Sizing annual debt service at 6.50%","431,695",""],["First-year contractual debt service at 6.25% (IO = 0 months)","421,760",""],["Sizing DSCR / first-year DSCR on UW NCF","1.250x / 1.279x",""],["Sizing debt yield / LTV at maximum loan","10.21% / 63.63%",""]]}},{"heading":"Sources, uses and cash to borrower","paragraphs":["At the maximum loan the refinance is cash-out. Net cash to the borrower is the loan less the $3,400,000 existing payoff, the 1.00% origination fee on actual initial principal ($53,279) and $48,000 of fixed closing costs, equal to $1,826,648. No fee capitalization, interest reserve, cash sweep, earn-out or holdback is assumed (Lender-Terms.pdf p.1); origination is calculated on actual initial principal, so a smaller final loan reduces the fee proportionally."],"table":{"headers":["Sources / uses","Amount (USD)"],"rows":[["Source - new first mortgage","5,327,928"],["Use - existing debt payoff","3,400,000"],["Use - origination fee at 1.00% of initial principal","53,279"],["Use - fixed closing costs","48,000"],["Net cash to borrower (negative would be cash in)","1,826,648"]]}},{"heading":"Sensitivities and downside","paragraphs":["Per the plan's sensitivity instruction, EGI is reduced 5%, the management fee minimum is recomputed and all other operating expense and reserve assumptions are held constant. EGI of $729,737 with a $29,189 management fee gives stressed NOI before reserves of $507,347 and stressed NCF of $502,747 - within about $253 of T12 actual NOI, which indicates that the forward scenario's benefit over history is roughly a 5% revenue assumption.","In the combined downside the sizing rate also rises 100 bps to 7.50% while the valuation cap rate is unchanged at 6.50%. The annual debt constant rises to 0.08867894; DSCR allows $4,535,438, LTV allows $5,073,473 (65% of $7,805,344) and debt yield allows $5,637,193. The combined-downside maximum loan is $4,535,438, DSCR still binding, a reduction of about $792,489 (14.9%) from base. Cash to borrower would fall to roughly $1,042,084, still cash-out but with a materially thinner margin. A separate cap-rate sensitivity of +50 bps (7.00%) lowers indicative value to $7,774,546 and the LTV limit to $5,053,455; because DSCR remains the tighter test at the unchanged 6.50% sizing rate, the maximum loan is unchanged at $5,327,928 in that single-variable case."],"table":{"headers":["Scenario","UW NOI before reserves","UW NCF","Indicative value","Maximum loan","Binding"],"rows":[["Base","544,218","539,618","8,372,588","5,327,928","DSCR"],["EGI -5% (management recomputed)","507,347","502,747","7,805,344","4,965,714","DSCR"],["Cap rate +50 bps only","544,218","539,618","7,774,546","5,327,928","DSCR"],["Combined: EGI -5% and sizing rate +100 bps","507,347","502,747","7,805,344","4,535,438","DSCR"]]}},{"heading":"Assumptions, limitations and unresolved evidence","paragraphs":["Assumptions used: all rates, ratios, expense treatments and cost inputs are taken unchanged from the packet - 6.25% contract rate, 6.50% sizing floor, 25-year monthly amortization, 0 months interest-only, 60-month maturity, 65% LTV, 1.25x DSCR on NCF after reserves, 9.00% debt yield on NOI before reserves, 6.50% cap rate on NOI before reserves, 1.00% origination fee, $48,000 fixed closing costs and $3,400,000 existing payoff. Sizing uses unrounded intermediate values; displayed dollars are rounded for readability only.","Unresolved evidence and unknowns: (1) Insurance - the plan asserts a fictional insurer renewal confirmation dated 2026-08-25 at $27,600 and instructs its use, but no insurer document is included in the packet; the $27,600 is therefore treated as the plan's underwriting allowance and no independently verified renewal premium is reported. T12 actual insurance was $25,200. (2) Suite 101 - the rent roll is stale at $7,000 and the unsigned broker proposal at $8,000 is not authoritative; $7,500 per the executed amendment is used. (3) The renewal option for suite 101 is not evidenced as exercised. (4) No appraisal, environmental report, property condition report, market comparables, tenant financials, sponsor track record, guarantor information, title, survey or credit approval is supplied; indicative value is a capitalization convention, not an appraisal. (5) The forward operating plan is a supplied scenario, not a lender-approved forecast, and the T12 has not been audited or normalized beyond the plan's stated adjustments. (6) No leasing capital, tenant improvement or downtime reserve is underwritten despite near-term rollover.","Key risks: DSCR binds exactly at 1.25x, so any downward revision to underwritten NOI reduces proceeds roughly dollar-for-dollar through the DSCR test; the forward scenario carries approximately $44,544 more EGI and $36,618 more NOI than T12 actuals, and on T12 NCF the loan would not clear 1.25x coverage; 21.7% of area rolls in the first loan year and 12.2% is vacant; expense normalization depends on the $4,800 casualty removal and the unverified insurance allowance; and refinance risk exists at the 60-month maturity with roughly 88% of principal outstanding under 25-year amortization.","Prepayment friction: 1% of outstanding principal if prepaid in loan years 1-2, with no stated bank penalty thereafter. No swap or hedge is assumed in this scenario, so no swap breakage or termination payment applies; no yield-maintenance or defeasance formula is stated (Lender-Terms.pdf p.1). Third-party costs of a future prepayment are not quantified in the packet.","This memorandum is prepared for internal review only. It is not a credit commitment, appraisal, legal opinion or offer, and all parties, addresses and documents are fictional. No market, sponsor or lender claims beyond the packet are made or implied."]},{"heading":"Source references and deliverables","paragraphs":["Sources: Rent-Roll.xlsx, worksheet 'Rent Roll', rows 6-19 (suite, area, status, rent, expiry and reconciliation notes). Lease-File.pdf p.1 (parties, term, base rent, deposit, renewal option, authority) and p.2 (executed first amendment; unsigned broker proposal; manager note). T12-Statement.pdf p.1 (monthly Sep-25 through Feb-26 and footnote on below-the-line items) and p.2 (Mar-26 through Aug-26 and Annual column). Property-and-Plan.pdf p.1 (as-of date, payoff, closing costs, transaction context, NOI/NCF labeling instruction) and p.2 (underwriting plan, expense treatments, insurance evidence, sensitivity instruction). Lender-Terms.pdf p.1 (all sizing tests, rates, amortization, IO, maturity, fees, prepayment).","Deliverables: this memorandum (PDF) and an underwriting workbook, artifacts/underwriting-v1.xlsx, containing Assumptions (editable), Rent Roll, T12 Historical, Underwriting, Loan Sizing, Sources and Uses, Sensitivity and a Map sheet locating every reviewer input and headline output. Editable inputs include cap rate (Assumptions!B8), sizing rate increment (Assumptions!B11), gross potential rent (Assumptions!B5), other income (Assumptions!B7), revenue loss percentage (Assumptions!B6), contract rate, amortization, IO months, cap-rate increment (Assumptions!B24) and EGI stress factor (Assumptions!B25); all NOI, NCF, value, sizing, sources-and-uses and sensitivity outputs recalculate live from those cells."]}]
